★ Request
Flashback off
Show Buena Vista (Casual Clothes)
Yeah!

Sorry about that. I'm okay now.
...I've finally graduated from that.

I'm so glad to see you again too.
Um, do you still sell mugwort manju?
...Same old Trainer.

Huh, yokan...?
Didn't you tell me before that you didn't like it because it was too sweet...?
Hm? Wait, this handwriting—I've seen it before...

...Ah, checking the menu.
Hehe, such a serious look.
...Yeah!

...! Yes.
Is the break over?

We went to buy reference books together, didn't we?
We bought croquettes at that butcher shop over there and split them in half...

"May I become worthy of Buena."
...Huh?
Huh... really? Lately too?
Ah, haha, sorry for asking out of nowhere, okay?
...We were never really apart at all.
Huh? You want to go back to our hometown? With me...?

...Even though we spent so much time apart.
Even though so many things have changed...
About the you that I don't know.

(So please, watch over me. So that you don't have to look worried.
So that I can show you a cheerful smile...!)

—Of course that handwriting looked familiar.
Because it was something I wrote just recently...!

I just felt like asking.
...About how you were while we were apart.

...! Yes!
Trainer, is the same one okay with you?
—I see. Here too...

Come to think of it, we have pool training after this, right?
I'm so glad! Going in right now is going to feel so good.
(—Clack)

...We used to come pray together all the time, didn't we?
For all sorts of things.

We used to play hide-and-seek a lot, didn't we?
Covering our eyes by that tree over there, going 'one, two...'
From "lonely little Buu-chan," maybe?

Huh? Ah... no, it's nothing!
You know, it's getting hot out. I kind of zoned out.

You were always hiding in the exact same spot.
...You "did that on purpose," didn't you?

Oh my, if it isn't Buena-chan and company! Well, well,
both of you have grown into such fine adults~! I'm so glad you came back to visit!

! No. ...Or rather, I see.
Were you worried about me?

I was wondering why you invited me out,
but... that was why.

Oh, that's right. We have yokan, too.
It's your recent favorite, isn't it, miss?

All this time, you remained just as you were...
Your heart was always right beside me...
...Well, let's see.

...Hey, what does this mean?
Could you... tell me?

...Hey, could we stop by the shrine one last time before we go?
There's something I want to wish for.
Of course we do! You always loved them, didn't you? Want some today?

Oh, that's right. We have yokan, too.
It's your recent favorite, isn't it, lad?
(Clang, clang——Clap, clap)

(...I'm not a child anymore.
I'll hurry and become an adult. I'll get over being lonely, too.)
Hehe, so the truth is a secret? ...Then I won't ask anymore either.

Let's see, from over here... Ah, an ema fell down!
I wonder if the string snapped...
...It's just the way it was.

!
Ma'am, it's been such a long time.

...I see.
No, all the more reason why we really have to say thank you!

...I see, it's delicious after all!
In that case, let's buy some of that too.
...Hey, what else?
...Phew.

...Huh? A day off?
Yeah, I'm free. What's up?

For tomorrow's sports day!
Please let the weather be completely sunny! Please~~!

—I told her everything. The shock when I saw how much she had grown in her running.
How I studied desperately to stand beside someone so far out of my reach, even praying to the gods...

*hic*, *sob*... Please let Big Bro's scrape...
...heal quick...!

*hic*, *sob*... Please let Big Sis's scrape...
...heal quick...!
...Were you working that hard all this time with that in mind?

...We got quite a lot of our wishes granted, didn't we?
I know, let's go give a prayer of thanks.

Wah... It's been so long...!
—Ah, look. That bookstore.
...Ah, that shop closed down...

Hehe, it's still completely overgrown with weeds.
This place hasn't changed either.
